text:
I've dropped off elderly family members for dental appointments several times at the temporary parking area of ​​the Borommanath Srinakarin Building, Faculty of Dentistry, Chulalongkorn University.

Positive +++: Convenient temporary parking, limited to 15 minutes.
Negative ---: Staff at the booth are unwelcoming, unfriendly, and unhelpful, lacking information – this applies to all of them.

Please address this urgently to maintain a positive image for the Faculty.

text: Providing excellent, clean, and safe care, the clinic follows a step-by-step treatment plan. This is a crucial solution to oral and dental health issues.
